patch.value: Coverage gate excludes executable tooling and the merge-driver hook is JavaScript

The 100 percent gate walks coverageGate.sources=["."] but DEFAULT_SKIP_DIRS excludes scripts, so scripts/coverage-gate.ts, scripts/docstring-gate.ts, and scripts/prepare-merge-driver.mjs are outside the measured source set. The last file is executable JavaScript despite the fleet TypeScript-only requirement. Existing index.ts coverage remains exact, but the package cannot honestly claim all-source 100/100/100/100 until tooling is migrated, independently tested, included in the measured inventory, and statement-equivalent coverage is explicitly reported or justified by the runtime.

Replace executable .mjs with erasable TypeScript or an approved zero-logic launcher; measure every package-owned executable TypeScript source including gate scripts; enforce exact lines branches functions and an explicit statement-equivalence contract; negative controls prove a new untested root or scripts source fails; release check and fresh install pass
Every executable package-owned source file is TypeScript, enumerated by the exact coverage inventory, independently tested, and gated at exact coverage without ignores or source exclusions.
The gate reports only index.ts and intentionally prunes scripts; one executable hook is .mjs.
